info.title: ZorDMS Core Service
info.description: Document management core service: capture, indexing, catalog, mapper, records/legal-hold lifecycle, doc-type registry, and internal integration ingest. User routes use bearer JWT; /integration/* uses the shared x-internal-token (set after the integration hub verifies the inbound external webhook HMAC).

bearerAuth.description: User JWT issued by the gateway; carries RBAC roles + permissions.

internalToken.name: x-internal-token
internalToken.description: Shared internal service token. The integration hub authenticates the inbound external webhook via HMAC, then forwards to these endpoints with this token.

FieldObject.description: A doc-type field: either a bare field name or a {name,type?,mandatory?} object.
